about: Slashdot (tech news and discussion). The CLI reads the front page, sections, tag/firehose listings, stories and comments, popular and recent submissions, polls, user profiles and comments, the story archive and the RSS feed, and can vote in polls.

commands.summary: List the latest front-page stories on Slashdot, with id, title, link, byline and summary.
List the stories on a section front page (subdomain such as science, yro, linux, hardware, developers, news).

params.name: section
params.description: Section subdomain, e.g. science, yro, linux, hardware, developers, news, tech, devices, build, entertainment, technology

commands.summary: List firehose items (stories and submissions) filtered by a tag or topic keyword, e.g. ubuntu, space, crime, medicine.

params.name: tag
params.description: Tag or topic filter, e.g. news, ubuntu, gnome, os, space, crime, medicine

commands.summary: List the most recent user submissions to the firehose, with pagination. The summary starts with '<submitter> writes:'.
Get a story's title, byline, summary text and firehose id. The story is identified by its sid date path yy/mm/dd/id.

params.name: yy
params.description: Two-digit year from the story URL

params.name: id
params.description: Numeric story id from the URL, e.g. 050211 (keep leading zeros)

commands.summary: List the comments shown on a story page (the default threshold view), with subject, author, score and text.

params.name: yy
params.description: Two-digit year from the story URL

params.name: id
params.description: Numeric story id from the URL (keep leading zeros)

commands.summary: List Slashdot polls. Each summary has the comment count, question, vote count and posting date; the url holds the poll id for get-poll-results.
Get the results of a poll by id: each answer with its vote count and percentage.
Get a user's profile page: their recent activity (comments, stories, submissions) with scores and links.
List a user's recent comments with subject, comment link, date and the story each is attached to.
Browse the story archive: last week by default, or stories for a topic/section keyword and year, or by time for a year.

params.name: op
params.description: Archive mode. Omit for the last 7 days. 'topics' or 'sections' together with a keyword. 'bytime' with a year.

params.name: keyword
params.description: Topic or section keyword, e.g. ai, linux (with op=topics/sections)

params.name: year
params.description: Four-digit year to restrict to, e.g. 2017

commands.summary: Get the main Slashdot RSS (RDF) feed of current stories, with title, link, author, date and description.
